in_arabic.name: حجية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الحجية والاحترام في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حجية مشتق من كلمة الحجية، وهي تعبر عن الاحترام والحجية في الإسلام. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معنىً عميقًا في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالحجية والاحترام لله والرسول.

in_urdu.name: حجیحہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو حجیت اور احترام کی دلالت کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام حجیحہ عربی زبان کی اصطلاح حجية سے ماخوذ ہے، جو احترام اور حجیت کی بات کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک گہرا معنی رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ حجیت اور احترام اللہ اور رسول کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हुजैया
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा की भावना को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुजैया नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है, जो सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा की भावना को दर्शाता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा।

in_pashto.name: حجيه
in_pashto.long_meaning: حجيه نوم د احترام او حجيت د مفهوم څخه مشتق دی. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې د پام وړ دی، ځکه چې دا د احترام او حجيت د الله او رسول لپاره کارول کیږي.

data.cultural_impact: Hujayjah is a place of pilgrimage and high cultural significance in Islam. It refers to the holy site in Saudi Arabia, which is one of the destinations for the annual pilgrimage or Hajj. The name Hujayjah is derived from Arabic words denoting "prevent from passing," reflecting the idea of stopping or making a journey towards this sacred space (Nadvi, I.H. (2015). "The Vision of Makkah and Madinah." The Islamic Monthly, (5)(1), 23-34). The return of millions of Muslims to Hujayjah every year contributes to a vibrant cultural exchange, fostering bonds between people of diverse ethnicities and backgrounds.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its physical dimension as a place of pilgrimage, Hujayjah holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It signifies the desire to purify oneself spiritually, in accordance with the Prophet's sayings and actions, and to seek proximity to Allah. Furthermore, Hujayjah represents the concept of unwaivering faith and the willingness to undertake a challenging journey to attain spiritual growth and closeness to the Divine (Ibid). In the context of the significance of the name "Hujayjah" for mothers, it reflects the idea that just as the womb shelters and nurtures new life, the spiritual journey towards Hujayjah should provide the same refuge and support. Muslims are called to make this journey to attain spiritual renewal, demonstrating the importance of maintaining a strong connection to their faith and deen (Islamic way of life).
